classification: security-critical: current read authority, egress and delivery evidence

tests.command: .venv/bin/ruff check apps services scripts tests database/migrations deploy/crawler-network
.venv/bin/ruff format --check apps services scripts tests database/migrations deploy/crawler-network

local_failure_accounting: Initial migration used public.digest under a pg_catalog search path; replaced with built-in sha256 without changing migration execution.
Real PostgreSQL failures caught the updated RLS table count, UUID4 egress identity, and required live frontier lease; fixed the implementation and assertions.
New fixture failures caught a missing dataclasses import and unacknowledged outbox replay; fixed the fixture to acknowledge admitted messages.
An inherited instantaneous fetch double reported five milliseconds before wall time elapsed; the extended fixture now waits its declared elapsed time, preserving the temporal gate.

The new crawler-network test initially expected a redirect exception; the gateway correctly returns redirect_rejected evidence. The test now requires that outcome, no body, and no second origin resolution.

One repeated page-attempt lab invocation failed during disposable Docker setup before collecting tests. Docker remained healthy; a standalone repeat of the unchanged lab passed 1/0. No lab, test, or safety gate was weakened.

ui_review.mechanical_findings: One warning and four advisories, all pre-existing outside scoped CSS changes; existing design artifacts preserved.
ui_review.capture_limit: Native browser captures; a failed full-page DevTools capture was not used. Expanded receipt and keyboard interaction were not visually exercised.
